accepted.sentence: In many box-style units, full-height side panels carry shelf loads and connect the top and bottom into a rigid carcass.
Fixed shelves may sit in dadoes cut across the side panels, creating a broad glued joint rather than relying solely on pins.
Frameless construction mounts doors directly to the side panels, leaving the front edges visible instead of covering them with a face frame.
Sliding doors hang from rollers or ride in upper and lower tracks, moving laterally without projecting into the room.
A tambour door consists of narrow slats joined by flexible backing, allowing the panel to bend and roll into a housing.
Composite-board panels often receive thin edge banding over exposed edges to cover the core and reduce moisture entry.
Some doors sit flush within an opening, while overlay doors extend across part of the front frame.
A plinth may span the floor-level front, concealing the gap beneath the body and distributing its weight along a continuous base.
